+
+func applyChange(root string, c project.Change, a claim) error {
+	m, ok := module(a.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("module %s absent", c.Module)
+	}
+	path := filepath.Join(root, m.Dir, "SPEC.md")
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	sec, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Specs")
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(sec)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	remove := map[string]bool{}
+	replace := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	for _, x := range c.Removed {
+		remove[x.ID] = true
+	}
+	for _, x := range c.Modified {
+		replace[x.ID] = x
+	}
+	out := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, x := range items {
+		if remove[x.ID] {
+			continue
+		}
+		if y, ok := replace[x.ID]; ok {
+			out = append(out, y)
+		} else {
+			out = append(out, x)
+		}
+	}
+	out = append(out, c.Added...)
+	sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].ID < out[j].ID })
+	var specs strings.Builder
+	for _, x := range out {
+		specs.WriteString(contracts.RenderItem(x))
+		specs.WriteString("\n")
+	}
+	d.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body, "Specs", strings.TrimSpace(specs.String())+"\n")
+	if set, ok := c.Document.Frontmatter["set"].(map[string]any); ok {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			d.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	dec, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Decisions")
+	removed, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Removed decisions")
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if line != "" {
+			dec = strings.ReplaceAll(dec, line, "")
+		}
+	}
+	added, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Decisions")
+	added = strings.TrimSpace(added)
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				dec += "\n- " + c.Slug + ": " + line
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	d.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(dec)+"\n")
+	render, e := contracts.RenderDocument(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = os.WriteFile(path, []byte(render), 0644); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func Context(root, selector string, full bool) (string, error) {
+	s, e := Current(root, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	var out strings.Builder
+	out.WriteString("# Change\n")
+	body, _ := contracts.RenderDocument(s.Change.Document)
+	out.WriteString(body)
+	m, ok := module(s.Snapshot, s.Change.Module)
+	if ok {
+		out.WriteString("\n# Projected spec\n")
+		b, _ := contracts.RenderDocument(m.Document)
+		out.WriteString(b)
+	}
+	sys, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, "SYSTEM.md"))
+	out.WriteString("\n# SYSTEM\n")
+	out.Write(sys)
+	pb := s.Phase
+	if pb == "impl" && fmBool(s.Change.Document, "regenerate") {
+		pb = "regenerate"
+	}
+	play, e := assets.Playbook(pb)
+	if e == nil {
+		out.WriteString("\n# Playbook\n")
+		out.WriteString(play)
+	}
+	if ok {
+		for _, pattern := range m.Zones.Interface {
+			_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+				if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+					return nil
+				}
+				rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir), path)
+				rel = filepath.ToSlash(rel)
+				if !contracts.MatchGlob(pattern, rel) {
+					return nil
+				}
+				b, er := os.ReadFile(path)
+				if er == nil {
+					out.WriteString("\n# " + filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, rel)) + "\n")
+					out.Write(b)
+				}
+				return nil
+			})
+		}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(s.Snapshot.Root, path)
+			if rel == "" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			for _, p := range m.Zones.Interface {
+				if contracts.MatchGlob(p, strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Dir+"/")) {
+					return nil
+				}
+			}
+			info, er := d.Info()
+			if er != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			out.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n# %s (%d bytes)\n", filepath.ToSlash(rel), info.Size()))
+			if full {
+				b, er := os.ReadFile(path)
+				if er == nil {
+					out.Write(b)
+				}
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	return out.String(), nil
+}
+
+func Costs(root string) ([]model.CostSnapshot, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(r, ".fireweed", "runs")
+	out := []model.CostSnapshot{}
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+		if err != nil || d.IsDir() || d.Name() != "costs.json" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, er := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if er != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		var s model.CostSnapshot
+		if json.Unmarshal(b, &s) == nil {
+			out = append(out, s)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt) })
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	s, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	out := model.StatusReport{Modules: s.Modules, Queue: []model.StatusEntry{}, DriftSinceDrill: map[string]int{}, PhaseCommits: map[string]int{}, Costs: []model.ModuleCost{}}
+	for i, c := range q {
+		phase := fmString(c.Document, "phase")
+		if phase == "" {
+			phase = "queued"
+		}
+		x := model.StatusEntry{Slug: c.Slug, Path: c.Path, Module: c.Module, Phase: phase, Blocked: fmString(c.Document, "blocked"), AuditRounds: fmInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds")}
+		if x.Blocked == "" {
+			x.WaitingOn, x.WaitingRule = waiting(r, q, i)
+		}
+		out.Queue = append(out.Queue, x)
+	}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		for _, it := range specItems(m) {
+			if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "quarantine") {
+				reason := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(it.Tag, "quarantine:"))
+				out.Quarantines = append(out.Quarantines, model.Quarantine{Module: m.Name, ID: it.ID, Reason: reason})
+			}
+		}
+		if v, ok := m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"].(string); ok && v != "" {
+			out.BoundaryOptOuts = append(out.BoundaryOptOuts, model.BoundaryOptOut{Module: m.Name, Reason: v})
+		}
+		out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name] = 0
+	}
+	archives, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(r,"changes","archive","*.md"))
+	type applied struct { module,path string; date time.Time }
+	all := []applied{}
+	for _,path := range archives {
+		b,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil{continue}
+		doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if err!=nil||fmString(doc,"phase")!="applied"{continue}
+		mod:=fmString(doc,"module")
+		date:=implDate(doc)
+		all=append(all,applied{module:mod,path:path,date:date})
+		name:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path),".md")
+		if commits,err:=Commits(r,name);err==nil{out.PhaseCommits[name]=len(commits)}
+	}
+	sort.Slice(all,func(i,j int)bool{if all[i].date.Equal(all[j].date){return all[i].path<all[j].path};return all[i].date.After(all[j].date)})
+	if len(all)>=3 {
+		count:=1
+		for count<len(all)&&all[count].module==all[0].module{count++}
+		if count>=3{out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:"P08",Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes",all[0].module,count),Warning:true})}
+	}
+	for _,m:=range s.Modules {
+		var drill time.Time
+		if b,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(r,".fireweed","drills",m.Name+".md"));err==nil{if d,er:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));er==nil{drill=parseDate(fmt.Sprint(d.Frontmatter["date"]))}}
+		for _,x:=range all{if x.module==m.Name&&(drill.IsZero()||x.date.After(drill)){out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]++}}
+	}
+	base,_:=s.Config["base"].(string);if base==""{base="main"}
+	remote,_:=s.Config["remote"].(string);if remote==""{remote="origin"}
+	ref,err:=git(r,"rev-parse","--verify","refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
+	if err!=nil{ref,_=git(r,"rev-parse","--verify",base)}
+	for _,x:=range all{rel,_:=filepath.Rel(r,x.path);if _,err:=gitBytes(r,"show",ref+":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel));err!=nil{out.Unapproved++}}
+	costs, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	latestDiagnostics:=map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, snap := range costs {
+		for _, c := range snap.Modules {
+			latest[c.Module] = c
+			latestDiagnostics[c.Module]=snap.Diagnostics
+		}
+	}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if c, ok := latest[m.Name]; ok {
+			out.Costs = append(out.Costs, c)
+			for _,d:=range latestDiagnostics[m.Name]{
+				if d.Code!="B01"&&d.Code!="B02"&&d.Code!="B03"{continue}
+				found:=false;for _,existing:=range out.Diagnostics{if existing==d{found=true;break}}
+				if !found{out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,d)}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+func parseDate(s string)time.Time{t,_:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,strings.TrimSpace(s));return t}
+func implDate(doc contracts.Document)time.Time{body,_:=contracts.Section(doc.Body,"Provenance");var date time.Time;for _,line:=range strings.Split(body,"\n"){f:=strings.Fields(line);if len(f)>=3&&f[0]=="-"&&f[1]=="impl"{date=parseDate(f[2])}};return date}
+
+func selectorPaths(root, selector string) (string, string, error) {
+	if selector == "" {
+		return "", "", coded("U02", "change selector missing")
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	paths := []string{}
+	for _, c := range q {
+		paths = append(paths, c.Path)
+	}
+	arch, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive", "*.md"))
+	for _, p := range arch {
+		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, p)
+		paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(rel))
+	}
+	matches := []string{}
+	for _, p := range paths {
+		base := filepath.Base(p)
+		slug := strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".md")
+		if i := strings.IndexByte(slug, '-'); i >= 0 {
+			slug = slug[i+1:]
+		}
+		if selector == p || selector == base || selector == slug || selector == strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".md") {
+			matches = append(matches, p)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(matches) != 1 {
+		valid:=[]string{}
+		for _,p:=range paths { name:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p),".md");if i:=strings.IndexByte(name,'-');i>=0{name=name[i+1:]};valid=append(valid,name) }
+		sort.Strings(valid)
+		return "", "", coded("U02", fmt.Sprintf("change %q not found or ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector,strings.Join(valid,", ")))
+	}
+	return matches[0], filepath.Base(matches[0]), nil
+}
+func Commits(root, selector string) ([]string, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	path, base, e := selectorPaths(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	paths := []string{path}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+		paths = append(paths, "changes/"+base)
+	} else {
+		paths = append(paths, "changes/archive/"+base)
+	}
+	logs, e := git(r, "rev-list", "HEAD", "--", paths[0], paths[1])
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []string{}
+	for _, oid := range strings.Fields(logs) {
+		parent, err := git(r, "rev-parse", oid+"^")
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		before, be := gitBytes(r, "show", parent+":"+paths[0])
+		if be != nil {
+			before, _ = gitBytes(r, "show", parent+":"+paths[1])
+		}
+		after, ae := gitBytes(r, "show", oid+":"+paths[0])
+		if ae != nil {
+			after, _ = gitBytes(r, "show", oid+":"+paths[1])
+		}
+		bd, ber := contracts.ParseDocument(string(before))
+		ad, aer := contracts.ParseDocument(string(after))
+		if ber == nil && aer == nil && fmString(bd, "phase") != fmString(ad, "phase") {
+			out = append(out, oid)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Abandon(root, selector string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = clean(r); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	path, _, e := selectorPaths(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+		return "", coded("P01", "applied change cannot be abandoned")
+	}
+	c, e := currentChange(r, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	oid, exists, err := gitstore.Ref(r, refName(c))
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if exists {
+		_, _, err = loadClaim(r, c)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", err
+		}
+	}
+	commits, e := Commits(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	for _, x := range commits {
+		if _, e = git(r, "revert", "--no-commit", x); e != nil {
+			return "", e
+		}
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(r, path)); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "-A", "--", path); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "commit", "-m", "fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if exists {
+		_ = gitstore.CASRef(r, refName(c), oid, "")
+	}
+	return git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+}
+
+type endpointConfigError struct{ cause error }
+
+func (e endpointConfigError) Error() string { return e.cause.Error() }
+func (e endpointConfigError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error) bool  { var x endpointConfigError; return errors.As(err, &x) }
+func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
+	}
+	if revisionRange == "" {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "empty range")
+	}
+	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
+	if len(parts) != 2 {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "unresolvable range "+revisionRange)
+	}
+	from, e := git(r, "rev-parse", parts[0])
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", revisionRange+": "+e.Error())
+	}
+	to, e := git(r, "rev-parse", parts[1])
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", revisionRange+": "+e.Error())
+	}
+	snap, e := project.LoadAt(r, to)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, endpointConfigError{e}
+	}
+	changes, e := git(r, "diff", "--name-only", from, to)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
+	}
+	endpoint, e := git(r,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",to,"--","changes")
+	if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},e}
+	endpointByName:=map[string]string{}
+	for _,path:=range strings.Fields(endpoint){if strings.HasSuffix(path,".md"){endpointByName[filepath.Base(path)]=path}}
+	selected:=map[string]string{}
+	for _,path:=range strings.Fields(changes){if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/"){if p,ok:=endpointByName[filepath.Base(path)];ok{selected[filepath.Base(path)]=p}}}
+	names:=make([]string,0,len(selected));for name:=range selected{names=append(names,name)};sort.Strings(names)
+	var b strings.Builder
+	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# Changes %s..%s\n\n", from, to)
+	for _,name:=range names{
+		path:=selected[name]
+		raw, err := gitBytes(r, "show", to+":"+path)
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		kind:="spec";if len(stringsOf(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]))>0{kind="eval_fix"}else if len(stringsOf(doc.Frontmatter["fixes"]))>0{kind="fix"}else if fmBool(doc,"regenerate"){kind="regenerate"}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## %s\n\nModule: %s\n\nKind: %s\n\nAudit rounds: %d\n\n", path, fmString(doc, "module"),kind,fmInt(doc,"audit_rounds"))
+		for _, n := range []string{"Added", "Modified", "Audit", "Decisions", "Removed decisions", "Provenance"} {
+			body, ok := contracts.Section(doc.Body, n)
+			if (n=="Added"||n=="Modified")&&ok {items,_:=contracts.ParseItems(body);body="";for _,it:=range items{if strings.Contains(it.Tag,"review"){body+=contracts.RenderItem(it)+"\n"}}}
+			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(body) != "" {
+				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "### %s\n\n%s\n\n", n, body)
+			}
+		}
+		pending:="changes/"+name;archive:="changes/archive/"+name
+		logs,_:=git(r,"rev-list",to,"--",pending,archive)
+		fileSet:=map[string]bool{}
+		for _,oid:=range strings.Fields(logs){
+			parent,err:=git(r,"rev-parse",oid+"^");if err!=nil{continue}
+			beforeRaw,err:=gitBytes(r,"show",parent+":"+pending);if err!=nil{beforeRaw,_=gitBytes(r,"show",parent+":"+archive)}
+			afterRaw,err:=gitBytes(r,"show",oid+":"+pending);if err!=nil{afterRaw,_=gitBytes(r,"show",oid+":"+archive)}
+			beforeDoc,be:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(beforeRaw));afterDoc,ae:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(afterRaw))
+			if be!=nil||ae!=nil||fmString(beforeDoc,"phase")==fmString(afterDoc,"phase"){continue}
+			if audit,ok:=contracts.Section(afterDoc.Body,"Audit");ok&&strings.Contains(audit,"- "){fmt.Fprintf(&b,"Prior audit finding at %s:\n%s\n",oid[:12],audit)}
+			files,_:=git(r,"diff","--name-only",parent,oid)
+			for _,file:=range strings.Fields(files){if strings.HasPrefix(file,"changes/"){continue};fileSet[file]=true}
+		}
+		files:=make([]string,0,len(fileSet));for file:=range fileSet{files=append(files,file)};sort.Strings(files)
+		if len(files)>0{fmt.Fprintf(&b,"### Files\n\n%s\n\n",strings.Join(files,"\n"))}
+	}
+	if len(names) == 0 {
+		b.WriteString("No changes selected.\n")
+	}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		for _, it := range specItems(m) {
+			if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "quarantine") {
+				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Quarantined %s %s: %s\n", m.Name, it.ID, strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(it.Tag,"quarantine:")))
+			}
+		}
+		if reason,ok:=m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"].(string);ok&&reason!=""{fmt.Fprintf(&b,"Boundary opt-out %s: %s\n",m.Name,reason)}
+	}
+	for _,path:=range strings.Fields(endpoint){if !strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/")||strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/archive/"){continue};raw,err:=gitBytes(r,"show",to+":"+path);if err!=nil{continue};d,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw));if err==nil&&fmString(d,"blocked")!=""{fmt.Fprintf(&b,"Blocked %s: %s\n",path,fmString(d,"blocked"))}}
+	costs,_:=Costs(r);latest:=map[string]model.ModuleCost{};diag:=map[string][]project.Diagnostic{};for _,snapshot:=range costs{for _,c:=range snapshot.Modules{latest[c.Module]=c;diag[c.Module]=snapshot.Diagnostics}}
+	report:=model.PRBodyReport{Body:"",Diagnostics:[]project.Diagnostic{}}
+	if len(latest)>0{b.WriteString("\n# Cost\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n|---|---:|---|---:|---:|\n");for _,m:=range snap.Modules{c,ok:=latest[m.Name];if !ok{continue};ids:=make([]string,0,len(c.CasesPerSpec));for id:=range c.CasesPerSpec{ids=append(ids,id)};sort.Strings(ids);pairs:=[]string{};for _,id:=range ids{pairs=append(pairs,fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d",id,c.CasesPerSpec[id]))};fmt.Fprintf(&b,"| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n",c.Module,c.Seconds,strings.Join(pairs,", "),c.EvalLines,c.DisposableLines);for _,d:=range diag[m.Name]{if d.Code!="B01"&&d.Code!="B02"&&d.Code!="B03"{continue};found:=false;for _,x:=range report.Diagnostics{if x==d{found=true}};if !found{report.Diagnostics=append(report.Diagnostics,d);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%s: %s\n",d.Code,d.Message)}}}}
+	report.Body=b.String();return report,nil
+}
+
+func GC(ctx context.Context, request model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(request.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	s, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	age := 720 * time.Hour
+	if x, ok := configMap(s, "gc")["drill_max_age"].(string); ok && x != "" {
+		age, e = time.ParseDuration(x)
+		if e != nil || age <= 0 {
+			return model.GCResult{}, coded("C01", "invalid gc.drill_max_age")
+		}
+	}
+	now := request.Now
+	if now.IsZero() {
+		now = time.Now().UTC()
+	}
+	listing, e := git(r, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/fireweed/claims", "refs/fireweed/attempts", "refs/fireweed/drills")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	out := model.GCResult{Pruned: []string{}}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(listing, "\n") {
+		parts := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(parts) != 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		ref, oid := parts[0], parts[1]
+		prune := false
+		if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/claims/") {
+			b, err := gitstore.ReadBlob(r, oid)
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			var x claim
+			if json.Unmarshal(b, &x) != nil {
+				prune = true
+			} else {
+				info, err := repo(x.Worktree)
+				prune = err != nil || info.CommonDir != "" && info.CommonDir != (func() string { z, _ := repo(r); return z.CommonDir }())
+			}
+		} else if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/attempts/") {
+			seg := strings.Split(ref, "/")
+			if len(seg) >= 5 {
+				_, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(r, "changes/archive", seg[3]+".md"))
+				prune = err == nil
+				if !prune {
+					matches, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(r, "changes/archive", "*-"+seg[3]+".md"))
+					prune = len(matches) > 0
+				}
+			}
+		} else if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/drills/") {
+			seg := strings.Split(ref, "/")
+			stamp := seg[len(seg)-1]
+			t, err := time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000", stamp)
+			if err == nil {
+				prune = t.Before(now.Add(-age))
+			}
+		}
+		if prune {
+			if err := gitstore.CASRef(r, ref, oid, ""); err == nil {
+				out.Pruned = append(out.Pruned, ref)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(out.Pruned)
+	return out, nil
+}

+func phaseState(root, selector string) (project.Change, claim, string, model.State, error) {
+	s, e := Current(root, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Change{}, claim{}, "", s, e
+	}
+	a, oid, e := loadClaim(s.Snapshot.Root, s.Change)
+	return s.Change, a, oid, s, e
+}
+func module(s project.Snapshot, name string) (project.Module, bool) {
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == name {
+			return m, true
+		}
+	}
+	return project.Module{}, false
+}
+func specItems(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {
+	sec, _ := contracts.Section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")
+	it, _ := contracts.ParseItems(sec)
+	return it
+}
+func enforced(items []contracts.Item) []contracts.Item {
+	out := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		if !strings.Contains(it.Tag, "quarantine") {
+			out = append(out, it)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func changedIDs(c project.Change) []string {
+	ids := []string{}
+	for _, it := range c.Added {
+		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range c.Modified {
+		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
+	}
+	ids = append(ids, stringsOf(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+	ids = append(ids, stringsOf(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])...)
+	return ids
+}
+func diff(root, base string) ([]gitstore.Change, error) {
+	out, e := git(root, "diff", "--name-status", base, "--")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	u, e := git(root, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	res := []gitstore.Change{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
+		if line == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		p := strings.Split(line, "\t")
+		if len(p) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		g := gitstore.Change{Status: p[0], Path: p[len(p)-1]}
+		if len(p) > 2 {
+			g.OldPath = p[1]
+		}
+		res = append(res, g)
+	}
+	for _, p := range strings.Split(u, "\n") {
+		if p != "" {
+			res = append(res, gitstore.Change{Status: "A", Path: p})
+		}
+	}
+	return res, nil
+}
+func zones(root string, c project.Change, a claim) error {
+	changes, e := diff(root, a.Base)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if len(changes) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if len(stringsOf(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+		m, ok := module(a.Snapshot, c.Module)
+		if !ok {
+			return fmt.Errorf("module %s absent", c.Module)
+		}
+		for _, x := range changes {
+			if x.Path == c.Path {
+				continue
+			}
+			if a.Phase == "evals" && strings.HasPrefix(x.Path, m.Dir+"/") && contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(x.Path, m.Dir+"/"), m.Zones) == "evals" {
+				continue
+			}
+			return coded("Z01", "forbidden edit "+x.Path)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: a.Snapshot, Module: c.Module, Phase: a.Phase, ChangePath: c.Path, Base: a.Base, InterfaceDeclared: isInterface(c), Changes: changes})
+	for _, d := range ds {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return coded(d.Code, d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func budgetWarnings(s project.Snapshot, costs []model.ModuleCost) []project.Diagnostic {
+	out := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	limitTime := 15 * time.Minute
+	if v, ok := configMap(s, "budgets")["verify_time"].(string); ok {
+		if d, e := time.ParseDuration(v); e == nil && d > 0 {
+			limitTime = d
+		}
+	}
+	caseLimit := optInt(s, "budgets", "cases_per_spec", 15)
+	ratioLimit := optInt(s, "budgets", "eval_ratio", 4)
+	total := 0.0
+	for _, c := range costs {
+		total += c.Seconds
+		ids := make([]string, 0, len(c.CasesPerSpec))
+		for id := range c.CasesPerSpec {
+			ids = append(ids, id)
+		}
+		sort.Strings(ids)
+		for _, id := range ids {
+			n := c.CasesPerSpec[id]
+			if n > caseLimit {
+				out = append(out, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B02", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s %s has %d cases, limit %d", c.Module, id, n, caseLimit), Warning: true})
+			}
+		}
+		if c.EvalLines > 0 && (c.DisposableLines == 0 || float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines) > float64(ratioLimit)) {
+			out = append(out, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B03", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds %d", c.Module, c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines, ratioLimit), Warning: true})
+		}
+	}
+	if total > limitTime.Seconds() {
+		out = append(out, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B01", Message: fmt.Sprintf("evaluated %.3f seconds exceeds limit %.3f seconds", total, limitTime.Seconds()), Warning: true})
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func lineCount(b []byte) int {
+	if len(b) == 0 {
+		return 0
+	}
+	n := 0
+	for _, x := range b {
+		if x == '\n' {
+			n++
+		}
+	}
+	if b[len(b)-1] != '\n' {
+		n++
+	}
+	return n
+}
+func measure(root string, m project.Module, r checks.Report) model.ModuleCost {
+	c := model.ModuleCost{Module: m.Name, Seconds: r.Seconds, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{}}
+	for _, x := range r.Cases {
+		for _, id := range x.IDs {
+			c.CasesPerSpec[id]++
+		}
+	}
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, er := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), path)
+		if er != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
+		if zone != "evals" && zone != "disposable" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		info, er := d.Info()
+		if er != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, er := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if er != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if zone == "evals" {
+			c.EvalLines += lineCount(b)
+		} else {
+			c.DisposableLines += lineCount(b)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	return c
+}
+func storeCosts(root string, s model.State, costs []model.ModuleCost, ds []project.Diagnostic) error {
+	snap := model.CostSnapshot{Run: s.Run, Phase: s.Phase, RecordedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Modules: costs, Diagnostics: ds}
+	dir := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", s.Run, s.Phase)
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(snap, "", "  ")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "costs.json"), b, 0644)
+}
+func selectedDependents(s project.Snapshot, target string, quick bool) []project.Module {
+	if quick {
+		return nil
+	}
+	mode, ok := s.Config["verify_dependents"].(string)
+	if !ok || mode == "" {
+		mode = "direct"
+	}
+	if mode == "none" {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := []project.Module{}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == target {
+			continue
+		}
+		direct := false
+		for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+			if d == target {
+				direct = true
+			}
+		}
+		if direct || mode == "all" && depends(s, m.Name, target) {
+			out = append(out, m)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func auditSubmission(c project.Change, a claim) (string, []string, error) {
+	body, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Audit")
+	body = strings.TrimSpace(body)
+	lines := strings.Split(body, "\n")
+	checked := []string{}
+	no := false
+	findings := []string{}
+	for _, line := range lines {
+		t := strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(t, "Checked IDs:") {
+			for _, id := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(t, "Checked IDs:")), ",") {
+				if x := strings.TrimSpace(id); x != "" {
+					checked = append(checked, x)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if t == "No findings" {
+			no = true
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(t, "-") {
+			findings = append(findings, t)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(findings) > 0 {
+		return "findings", findings, nil
+	}
+	if !no || len(checked) == 0 {
+		return "", nil, coded("P09", "audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")
+	}
+	for _, id := range changedIDs(c) {
+		found := false
+		for _, x := range checked {
+			if x == id {
+				found = true
+			}
+		}
+		if !found {
+			return "", nil, coded("P09", "audit did not check "+id)
+		}
+	}
+	return "no findings", checked, nil
+}
+
+var findingPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^- (?:\[untestable\] )?([A-Za-z]+-[0-9]+): "([^"]+)"`)
+
+func retainedFindings(c project.Change, a claim) []string {
+	section, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Audit")
+	m, ok := module(a.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil
+	}
+	specs := map[string]string{}
+	for _, it := range specItems(m) {
+		specs[it.ID] = it.Body
+	}
+	prior := map[string]bool{}
+	if a.AuditRounds > 0 {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(a.ApprovedAudit, "\n") {
+			parts := findingPattern.FindStringSubmatch(strings.TrimSpace(line))
+			if len(parts) == 3 {
+				prior[parts[1]] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	out := []string{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(section, "\n") {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		parts := findingPattern.FindStringSubmatch(line)
+		if len(parts) != 3 {
+			continue
+		}
+		body, exists := specs[parts[1]]
+		if !exists || !strings.Contains(body, parts[2]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if a.AuditRounds > 0 && !prior[parts[1]] {
+			continue
+		}
+		out = append(out, line)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	c, a, _, s, e := phaseState(req.Root, req.Change)
+	result := model.Result{State: s, Reports: map[string]checks.Report{}}
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if a.Phase != "evals" && a.Phase != "audit" && a.Phase != "impl" {
+		return result, coded("P01", "unsupported phase "+a.Phase)
+	}
+	if e = validateApproved(c, a); e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if e = stale(s.Snapshot.Root, c); e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if e = zones(s.Snapshot.Root, c, a); e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if a.Phase == "audit" {
+		_, _, e = auditSubmission(c, a)
+		return result, e
+	}
+	target, ok := module(a.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	if !ok {
+		return result, fmt.Errorf("module %s missing", c.Module)
+	}
+	mods := []project.Module{target}
+	if a.Phase == "impl" {
+		mods = append(mods, selectedDependents(a.Snapshot, c.Module, req.Quick)...)
+	}
+	var first error
+	costs := []model.ModuleCost{}
+	for _, m := range mods {
+		report, err := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: a.Snapshot, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		result.Reports[m.Name] = report
+		runDir := filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, ".fireweed", "runs", s.Run, s.Phase)
+		_ = os.MkdirAll(runDir, 0755)
+		if b, marshalErr := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  "); marshalErr == nil {
+			_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(runDir, m.Name+".json"), b, 0644)
+		}
+		_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(runDir, m.Name+".stdout"), []byte(report.Stdout), 0644)
+		_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(runDir, m.Name+".stderr"), []byte(report.Stderr), 0644)
+		costs = append(costs, measure(s.Snapshot.Root, m, report))
+		if err != nil && first == nil && (a.Phase != "evals" || len(report.Cases) == 0) {
+			first = err
+		}
+		if m.Name == c.Module {
+			if err = checks.RequireCoverage(report, enforced(specItems(m))); err != nil && first == nil {
+				first = err
+			}
+			if a.Phase == "evals" {
+				if len(stringsOf(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+					if err = checks.RequirePass(report, enforced(specItems(m))); err != nil && first == nil {
+						first = err
+					}
+				} else {
+					if err = checks.RequireFailFirst(report, changedIDs(c), stringsOf(c.Document.Frontmatter["already_satisfied"])); err != nil && first == nil {
+						first = err
+					}
+				}
+			} else if err = checks.RequirePass(report, enforced(specItems(m))); err != nil && first == nil {
+				first = err
+			}
+		} else if err = checks.RequirePass(report, enforced(specItems(m))); err != nil && first == nil {
+			first = err
+		}
+	}
+	result.Costs = costs
+	result.Diagnostics = budgetWarnings(a.Snapshot, costs)
+	_ = storeCosts(s.Snapshot.Root, s, costs, result.Diagnostics)
+	if a.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		ds, err := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: a.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ds...)
+		if err != nil && first == nil {
+			first = err
+		}
+		for _, d := range ds {
+			if !d.Warning && first == nil {
+				first = coded(d.Code, d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return result, first
+}
+func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) { return verify(ctx, req) }
+func provenance(c project.Change, phase string, req model.Request, reports map[string]checks.Report) string {
+	agent := req.Agent
+	if agent == "" {
+		agent = "manual"
+	}
+	pb := phase
+	if phase == "impl" && fmBool(c.Document, "regenerate") {
+		pb = "regenerate"
+	}
+	book, _ := assets.Playbook(pb)
+	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(book))
+	tests, fail, pass := 0, 0, 0
+	for _, r := range reports {
+		for _, x := range r.Cases {
+			tests++
+			if x.Result == "fail" {
+				fail++
+			} else {
+				pass++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d", phase, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), agent, assets.Version(), hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), tests, fail, pass)
+}
+func appendProvenance(doc contracts.Document, line string) contracts.Document {
+	old, _ := contracts.Section(doc.Body, "Provenance")
+	old = strings.TrimSpace(old)
+	if old != "" {
+		old += "\n"
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Provenance", old+line+"\n")
+	return doc
+}
+func writeChange(root string, c project.Change, d contracts.Document) error {
+	b, e := contracts.RenderDocument(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)), []byte(b), 0644)
+}
+func commitStep(root string, c project.Change, paths []string) (string, error) {
+	args := []string{"add", "-A", "--"}
+	args = append(args, paths...)
+	if _, e := git(root, args...); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return git(root, "commit", "-m", "fireweed: "+c.Slug+" phase transition")
+}
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	result, e := verify(ctx, req)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	c, a, oid, s, e := phaseState(req.Root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	root := s.Snapshot.Root
+	d := c.Document
+	old := a.Phase
+	paths := []string{c.Path}
+	if old == "evals" {
+		if optBool(a.Snapshot, "audit", "enabled", true) {
+			d.Frontmatter["phase"] = "audit"
+		} else {
+			d.Frontmatter["phase"] = "impl"
+		}
+	} else if old == "audit" {
+		kind, _, err := auditSubmission(c, a)
+		if err != nil {
+			return result, err
+		}
+		findings := retainedFindings(c, a)
+		if kind == "findings" {
+			if len(findings) == 0 {
+				// Discard invalid findings; a complete no-findings submission may advance.
+				body, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Audit")
+				if !strings.Contains(body, "No findings") {
+					return result, coded("P09", "audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")
+				}
+				if _, _, err = auditSubmission(project.Change{Document: d, Added: c.Added, Modified: c.Modified}, a); err != nil {
+					return result, err
+				}
+				d.Frontmatter["phase"] = "impl"
+			} else {
+				d.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body, "Audit", strings.Join(findings, "\n")+"\n")
+				rounds := a.AuditRounds
+				limit := optInt(a.Snapshot, "audit", "max_rounds", 2)
+				blocking := rounds >= limit
+				for _, f := range findings {
+					if strings.Contains(f, "[untestable]") {
+						blocking = true
+					}
+				}
+				if blocking {
+					d.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+					d.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body, "Questions", strings.Join(findings, "\n")+"\n")
+				} else {
+					d.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = rounds + 1
+					d.Frontmatter["phase"] = "evals"
+				}
+			}
+		} else {
+			d.Frontmatter["phase"] = "impl"
+		}
+	} else if old == "impl" {
+		if e = applyChange(root, c, a); e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		d.Frontmatter["phase"] = "applied"
+		paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("packages", c.Module, "SPEC.md")))
+		archive := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)
+		paths = append(paths, archive)
+	}
+	d = appendProvenance(d, provenance(c, old, req, result.Reports))
+	if e = writeChange(root, c, d); e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if old == "impl" {
+		archive := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "changes/archive"), 0755); e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		if e = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, c.Path), filepath.Join(root, archive)); e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+		if e = static(root); e != nil {
+			return result, e
+		}
+	}
+	changes, _ := diff(root, a.Base)
+	for _, x := range changes {
+		paths = append(paths, x.Path)
+	}
+	_, e = commitStep(root, c, paths)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	newHead, _ := repo(root)
+	a.Base = newHead.Head
+	a.Phase = fmString(d, "phase")
+	a.AuditRounds = fmInt(d, "audit_rounds")
+	a.ApprovedAudit = auditSignature(d)
+	if old == "impl" || fmString(d, "blocked") != "" {
+		_ = gitstore.CASRef(root, refName(c), oid, "")
+		result.State = model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: a.Snapshot, Run: a.Run, Phase: a.Phase, Head: newHead.Head, PhaseBase: newHead.Head}
+		if fmString(d, "blocked") != "" {
+			return result, coded("P06", "change blocked")
+		}
+		return result, nil
+	}
+	c, e = currentChange(root, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	newOID, e := saveClaim(root, c, a, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	result.State, e = state(root, c, a, newOID)
+	return result, e
+}

func Test_FLOW_126_PRBodyEndpointConfigError(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	base := head(t, root)
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", "[invalid endpoint configuration\n")
	commit(t, root, "invalid endpoint configuration")

	_, err := workflow.PRBody(root, base+".."+head(t, root))
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("PRBody accepted malformed endpoint configuration")
	}
	if !workflow.IsEndpointConfigError(err) {
		t.Errorf("IsEndpointConfigError(%v) = false, want true", err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_127_PRBodyUnresolvableRangeIsNotEndpointConfigError(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	_, err := workflow.PRBody(root, head(t, root)+"..not-a-commit")
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("PRBody accepted an unresolvable range")
	}
	if workflow.IsEndpointConfigError(err) {
		t.Errorf("IsEndpointConfigError(%v) = true, want false", err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_124_FLOW_125_PRBodyDisposableArtifactBoundaryAndRanges(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	base := head(t, root)
	for path, data := range map[string][]byte{
		"packages/alpha/internal/binary.dat": {0, 1, 2, 3},
		"packages/alpha/internal/large.txt":  []byte(strings.Repeat("L", 262145)),
		"packages/alpha/internal/exact.txt":  []byte(strings.Repeat("E", 262144)),
		"packages/alpha/internal/small.txt":  []byte("ordinary text\n"),
	} {
		full := filepath.Join(root, path)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(full, data, 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	commit(t, root, "new disposable artifacts")
	endpoint := head(t, root)
	t.Run("FLOW_124_binary_and_large_artifacts", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, base+".."+endpoint)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "binary.dat", "large.txt", "262145", "B04")
		if !regexp.MustCompile("(?m)(binary\\.dat[^\\n]*\\b4\\b|\\b4\\b[^\\n]*binary\\.dat)").MatchString(r.Body) {
			t.Errorf("binary artifact lacks its 4-byte size: %s", r.Body)
		}
		count := 0
		for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
			if d.Code == "B04" {
				count++
				if !d.Warning || !(strings.Contains(d.Message, "binary.dat") || strings.Contains(d.Message, "large.txt")) || strings.Contains(d.Message, "exact.txt") || strings.Contains(d.Message, "small.txt") {

	})

+
+func Block(req model.BlockRequest) (model.BlockResult, error) {
+	c, a, oid, s, e := phaseState(req.Root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	root := s.Snapshot.Root
+	if e = validateApproved(c, a); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if s.Head != a.Base {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, coded("P05", "changed HEAD since phase base")
+	}
+	n := 1
+	var ref string
+	for {
+		ref = fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", c.Slug, n)
+		_, exists, err := gitstore.Ref(root, ref)
+		if err != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, err
+		}
+		if !exists {
+			break
+		}
+		n++
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	tree, e := git(root, "write-tree")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	attempt, e := git(root, "commit-tree", tree, "-p", a.Base, "-m", "fireweed attempt "+c.Slug)

+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, ref, "", attempt); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "reset", "--hard", a.Base); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "clean", "-fd"); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	raw, e := gitBytes(root, "show", a.Base+":"+c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	baseDoc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	baseDoc.Frontmatter["run"] = a.Run
+	baseDoc.Frontmatter["phase"] = a.Phase
+	baseDoc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = req.Reason
+	baseAdded, _ := contracts.Section(baseDoc.Body, "Added")
+	oldItems, _ := contracts.ParseItems(baseAdded)
+	for i, old := range oldItems {
+		if i >= len(c.Added) { break }
+		if strings.HasPrefix(old.ID, "new:") { baseDoc.Body = strings.ReplaceAll(baseDoc.Body, old.ID, c.Added[i].ID) }
+	}
+	if e = writeChange(root, c, baseDoc); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "add", "--", c.Path); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "commit", "-m", "fireweed: block "+c.Slug); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, refName(c), oid, ""); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	head, e := repo(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	s.Head = head.Head
+	s.PhaseBase = head.Head
+	s.ClaimOID = ""
+	s.Change.Document = baseDoc
+	return model.BlockResult{State: s, AttemptRef: ref, AttemptOID: attempt}, nil
+}
+
+func StartFromAttempt(root, selector string, attempt int) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if attempt <= 0 {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P01", "attempt number must be positive")
+	}
+	c, e := currentChange(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	ref := fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", c.Slug, attempt)
+	oid, exists, e := gitstore.Ref(r, ref)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if !exists {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P01", "missing saved attempt "+strconv.Itoa(attempt))
+	}
+	if e = clean(r); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	eligible, e := Eligible(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if len(eligible) == 0 || eligible[0].Path != c.Path {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P01", "change is not first eligible")
+	}
+	if _, exists, _ := gitstore.Ref(r, refName(c)); exists {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P02", "change already claimed")
+	}
+	s, e := Start(r, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	patch, e := gitBytes(r, "diff", "--binary", oid+"^", oid, "--", ".", ":(exclude)"+c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	cmd := exec.Command("git", "apply", "--3way", "-")
+	cmd.Dir = r
+	cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(string(patch))
+	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
+	if err != nil {
+		return s, fmt.Errorf("restore attempt: %s: %w", strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), err)
+	}
+	saved, err := gitBytes(r, "show", oid+":"+c.Path)
+	if err == nil {
+		savedDoc, er := contracts.ParseDocument(string(saved))
+		if er == nil {
+			approved := s.Change.Document
+			for _, section := range []string{"Decisions", "Audit", "Questions"} {
+				body, ok := contracts.Section(savedDoc.Body, section)
+				if ok {
+					approved.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(approved.Body, section, body)
+				}
+			}
+			_ = writeChange(r, c, approved)
+		}
+	}
+	return Current(r, c.Slug)
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/core.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/core.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..af5dba07087c83f1730dfe14f7827128f7840873
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/core.go
@@ -0,0 +1,614 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+	Worktree       string           `json:"worktree"`
+	Change         string           `json:"change"`
+	Run            string           `json:"run"`
+	Phase          string           `json:"phase"`
+	Base           string           `json:"base"`
+	Snapshot       project.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"`
+	ApprovedAuthor string           `json:"approved_author"`
+	ApprovedAudit  string           `json:"approved_audit"`
+	AuditRounds    int              `json:"audit_rounds"`
+}
+
+func coded(code, msg string) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, msg) }
+func rootOf(root string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := filepath.Abs(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	r, e = filepath.EvalSymlinks(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return r, nil
+}
+func repo(root string) (gitstore.Repository, error) { return gitstore.Inspect(root) }
+func git(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+	c.Dir = root
+	c.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost")
+	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s: %w", strings.Join(args, " "), strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), e)
+	}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+}
+func gitBytes(root string, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+	c.Dir = root
+	b, e := c.Output()
+	return b, e
+}
+func clean(root string) error {
+	out, e := git(root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if out != "" {
+		return coded("P01", "dirty worktree")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func fmString(d contracts.Document, key string) string { v, _ := d.Frontmatter[key].(string); return v }
+func fmBool(d contracts.Document, key string) bool     { v, _ := d.Frontmatter[key].(bool); return v }
+func fmInt(d contracts.Document, key string) int {
+	switch v := d.Frontmatter[key].(type) {
+	case int:
+		return v
+	case float64:
+		return int(v)
+	case string:
+		n, _ := strconv.Atoi(v)
+		return n
+	}
+	return 0
+}
+func configMap(s project.Snapshot, key string) map[string]any {
+	v, _ := s.Config[key].(map[string]any)
+	return v
+}
+func optInt(s project.Snapshot, section, key string, def int) int {
+	v := configMap(s, section)[key]
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case int:
+		if x > 0 {
+			return x
+		}
+	case float64:
+		if x > 0 {
+			return int(x)
+		}
+	}
+	return def
+}
+func optBool(s project.Snapshot, section, key string, def bool) bool {
+	v, ok := configMap(s, section)[key].(bool)
+	if ok {
+		return v
+	}
+	return def
+}
+func stringsOf(v any) []string {
+	switch a := v.(type) {
+	case []string:
+		return a
+	case []any:
+		r := make([]string, 0, len(a))
+		for _, x := range a {
+			if s, ok := x.(string); ok {
+				r = append(r, s)
+			}
+		}
+		return r
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func randID() string                  { b := make([]byte, 16); _, _ = rand.Read(b); return hex.EncodeToString(b) }
+func refName(c project.Change) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/" + c.Slug }
+func currentChange(root, selector string) (project.Change, error) {
+	q, e := project.Queue(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	if selector == "" {
+		return project.Change{}, coded("P02", "worktree holds no change")
+	}
+	var matches []project.Change
+	for _, c := range q {
+		if selector == c.Slug || selector == c.Path || selector == filepath.Base(c.Path) || selector == strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path), ".md") {
+			matches = append(matches, c)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(matches) == 1 {
+		return matches[0], nil
+	}
+	valid := make([]string, 0, len(q))
+	for _, c := range q {
+		valid = append(valid, c.Slug)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(valid)
+	if len(matches) > 1 {
+		return project.Change{}, coded("U02", fmt.Sprintf("change %q ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", ")))
+	}
+	return project.Change{}, coded("U02", fmt.Sprintf("change %q not found; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", ")))
+}
+func loadClaim(root string, c project.Change) (claim, string, error) {
+	oid, exists, e := gitstore.Ref(root, refName(c))
+	if e != nil {
+		return claim{}, "", e
+	}
+	if !exists {
+		return claim{}, "", coded("P02", "change has no claim")
+	}
+	b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return claim{}, "", e
+	}
+	var a claim
+	if e = json.Unmarshal(b, &a); e != nil {
+		return a, "", e
+	}
+	if a.Worktree != root {
+		return a, "", coded("P02", "change claimed by another worktree")
+	}
+	return a, oid, nil
+}
+func saveClaim(root string, c project.Change, a claim, old string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := json.Marshal(a)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	oid, e := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, b)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, refName(c), old, oid); e != nil {
+		return "", coded("P02", e.Error())
+	}
+	return oid, nil
+}
+func state(root string, c project.Change, a claim, oid string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := repo(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	a.Snapshot.Root = root
+	return model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: a.Snapshot, Run: a.Run, Phase: a.Phase, Head: r.Head, PhaseBase: a.Base, ClaimOID: oid}, nil
+}
+func authorSignature(d contracts.Document) string {
+	f := map[string]any{}
+	for k, v := range d.Frontmatter {
+		switch k {
+		case "run", "phase", "blocked", "audit_rounds":
+			continue
+		default:
+			f[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	b, _ := json.Marshal(f)
+	names := []string{"Motivation", "Interface", "Added", "Modified", "Removed", "Removed decisions"}
+	var out strings.Builder
+	out.Write(b)
+	for _, n := range names {
+		v, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, n)
+		out.WriteString("\n## " + n + "\n" + v)
+	}
+	return out.String()
+}
+func auditSignature(d contracts.Document) string {
+	v, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Audit")
+	return v
+}
+func validateApproved(c project.Change, a claim) error {
+	if authorSignature(c.Document) != a.ApprovedAuthor {
+		return coded("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+	}
+	if fmString(c.Document, "run") != a.Run || fmString(c.Document, "phase") != a.Phase {
+		return coded("P03", "approved run or phase changed")
+	}
+	if fmInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds") != a.AuditRounds {
+		return coded("P03", "approved audit state changed")
+	}
+	if a.Phase != "audit" && auditSignature(c.Document) != a.ApprovedAudit {
+		return coded("P03", "approved audit state changed")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func stale(root string, c project.Change) error {
+	ss, e := project.StaleSpecs(root, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, x := range ss {
+		if !x.Recovered {
+			return coded("P05", "stale base for "+x.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func static(root string) error {
+	for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return coded(d.Code, d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func approval(root string, c project.Change, snap project.Snapshot) ([]project.Diagnostic, error) {
+	base, _ := snap.Config["base"].(string)
+	if base == "" {
+		base = "main"
+	}
+	local, localErr := git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", base)
+	remote, _ := snap.Config["remote"].(string)
+	if remote == "" {
+		remote = "origin"
+	}
+	shared, sharedErr := git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
+	if sharedErr != nil {
+		shared = local
+	}
+	if localErr != nil {
+		local = ""
+	}
+	approved := false
+	for _, ref := range []string{local, shared} {
+		if ref == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, e := gitBytes(root, "show", ref+":"+c.Path); e == nil {
+			approved = true
+		}
+	}
+	ds := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	if !approved {
+		ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P04", Message: "change is absent from local and shared base", Path: c.Path, Warning: true})
+	}
+	if shared != "" {
+		files, _ := git(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "HEAD", "--", "changes/archive")
+		count := 0
+		for _, path := range strings.Fields(files) {
+			if !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".md") {
+				continue
+			}
+			if _, e := gitBytes(root, "show", shared+":"+path); e != nil {
+				count++
+			}
+		}
+		limit := optInt(snap, "authoring", "max_unapproved", 5)
+		if count >= limit {
+			return append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P07", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%d unapproved archives reach limit %d", count, limit)}), coded("P07", fmt.Sprintf("%d unapproved archives reach limit %d", count, limit))
+		}
+	}
+	return ds, nil
+}
+func isInterface(c project.Change) bool {
+	s, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Interface")
+	return strings.TrimSpace(s) != ""
+}
+func depends(s project.Snapshot, from, to string) bool {
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	var visit func(string) bool
+	visit = func(n string) bool {
+		if seen[n] {
+			return false
+		}
+		seen[n] = true
+		for _, m := range s.Modules {
+			if m.Name == n {
+				for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+					if d == to || visit(d) {
+						return true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	return visit(from)
+}
+func waiting(root string, q []project.Change, i int) (string, string) {
+	c := q[i]
+	snap, e := project.Project(root, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
+		b := q[j]
+		if fmString(b.Document, "blocked") == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if c.Module == b.Module {
+			return b.Slug, "same_module"
+		}
+		if depends(snap, c.Module, b.Module) {
+			return b.Slug, "depends_on_blocked"
+		}
+		if isInterface(c) && depends(snap, b.Module, c.Module) {
+			return b.Slug, "interface_dependency"
+		}
+	}
+	return "", ""
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	for i, c := range q {
+		if fmString(c.Document, "blocked") != "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		w, _ := waiting(r, q, i)
+		if w == "" {
+			out = append(out, c)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func assignIDs(root string, c project.Change) (project.Change, error) {
+	content, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)))
+	if e != nil {
+		return c, e
+	}
+	src := string(content)
+	if !strings.Contains(src, "new:") {
+		return c, nil
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(root, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return c, e
+	}
+	prefix := ""
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name == c.Module {
+			prefix = m.IDPrefix
+		}
+	}
+	if prefix == "" {
+		return c, fmt.Errorf("module %s missing", c.Module)
+	}
+	used := map[int]bool{}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name != c.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		sec, _ := contracts.Section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")
+		items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(sec)
+		for _, it := range items {
+			var n int
+			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, x := range append(append([]contracts.Item{}, c.Added...), c.Modified...) {
+		var n int
+		if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(x.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
+			used[n] = true
+		}
+	}
+	next := 1
+	for _, it := range c.Added {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(it.ID, "new:") {
+			continue
+		}
+		for used[next] {
+			next++
+		}
+		id := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, next)
+		src = strings.ReplaceAll(src, it.ID, id)
+		used[next] = true
+	}
+	if e = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(c.Path)), []byte(src), 0644); e != nil {
+		return c, e
+	}
+	return currentChange(root, c.Slug)
+}
+func Start(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = clean(r); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	eligible, e := Eligible(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if len(eligible) == 0 {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P01", "no eligible change")
+	}
+	chosen := eligible[0]
+	if selector != "" {
+		c, err := currentChange(r, selector)
+		if err != nil {
+			return model.State{}, err
+		}
+		if c.Path != chosen.Path {
+			return model.State{}, coded("P01", "change is not first eligible")
+		}
+	}
+	if _, exists, _ := gitstore.Ref(r, refName(chosen)); exists {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P02", "change already claimed")
+	}
+	if e = static(r); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = stale(r, chosen); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	loaded, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	approvalDS, approvalErr := approval(r, chosen, loaded)
+	if approvalErr != nil {
+		return model.State{Diagnostics: approvalDS}, approvalErr
+	}
+	head, e := repo(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	unstarted := fmString(chosen.Document, "phase") == ""
+	if unstarted {
+		chosen, e = assignIDs(r, chosen)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		d := chosen.Document
+		phase := "evals"
+		fixes := stringsOf(d.Frontmatter["fixes"])
+		evalFix := stringsOf(d.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])
+		if fmBool(d, "regenerate") || (len(chosen.Added)+len(chosen.Modified)+len(chosen.Removed)+len(fixes)+len(evalFix) == 0) {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+		d.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+		d.Frontmatter["run"] = randID()
+		body, err := contracts.RenderDocument(d)
+		if err != nil {
+			return model.State{}, err
+		}
+		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(r, filepath.FromSlash(chosen.Path)), []byte(body), 0644); err != nil {
+			return model.State{}, err
+		}
+		chosen, e = currentChange(r, chosen.Slug)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(r, chosen.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snap.Root = r
+	a := claim{Worktree: r, Change: chosen.Path, Run: fmString(chosen.Document, "run"), Phase: fmString(chosen.Document, "phase"), Base: head.Head, Snapshot: snap, ApprovedAuthor: authorSignature(chosen.Document), ApprovedAudit: auditSignature(chosen.Document), AuditRounds: fmInt(chosen.Document, "audit_rounds")}
+	oid, e := saveClaim(r, chosen, a, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	s, e := state(r, chosen, a, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	s.Diagnostics = append(s.Diagnostics, approvalDS...)
+	if fmBool(chosen.Document,"regenerate") {
+		latest:=time.Time{}
+		paths,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(r,"changes","archive","*.md"))
+		for _,path:=range paths { b,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil{continue};d,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if err!=nil||fmString(d,"module")!=chosen.Module||fmString(d,"phase")!="applied"{continue};date:=implDate(d);if date.After(latest){latest=date} }
+		passing:=false
+		if b,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(r,".fireweed","drills",chosen.Module+".md"));err==nil{if d,er:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));er==nil{date:=parseDate(fmt.Sprint(d.Frontmatter["date"]));passing=date.After(latest)&&fmString(d,"result")=="pass"}}
+		if !passing{s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:"P10",Message:"no passing drill newer than latest applied implementation for "+chosen.Module,Warning:true})}
+	}
+	if fmBool(chosen.Document, "regenerate") && unstarted {
+		for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+			if m.Name != chosen.Module {
+				continue
+			}
+			_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil
+				}
+				if d.IsDir() {
+					return nil
+				}
+				rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(r, m.Dir), path)
+				if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones) == "disposable" {
+					_ = os.Remove(path)
+				}
+				return nil
+			})
+		}
+	}
+	return s, nil
+}
+func Current(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if selector == "" {
+		q, err := project.Queue(r)
+		if err != nil {
+			return model.State{}, err
+		}
+		for _, c := range q {
+			a, oid, err := loadClaim(r, c)
+			if err == nil {
+				return state(r, c, a, oid)
+			}
+		}
+		return model.State{}, coded("P02", "worktree holds no change")
+	}
+	c, e := currentChange(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	a, oid, e := loadClaim(r, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(r, c, a, oid)
+}
+func Release(root, selector string) error {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if selector == "" {
+		s, err := Current(r, "")
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		selector = s.Change.Slug
+	}
+	c, e := currentChange(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	_, oid, e := loadClaim(r, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return gitstore.CASRef(r, refName(c), oid, "")
+}

+var _ = checks.RequirePass

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"

+
+func applyChange(root string, c project.Change, a claim) error {
+	m, ok := module(a.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("module %s absent", c.Module)
+	}
+	path := filepath.Join(root, m.Dir, "SPEC.md")
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	sec, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Specs")
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(sec)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	remove := map[string]bool{}
+	replace := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	for _, x := range c.Removed {
+		remove[x.ID] = true
+	}
+	for _, x := range c.Modified {
+		replace[x.ID] = x
+	}
+	out := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, x := range items {
+		if remove[x.ID] {
+			continue
+		}
+		if y, ok := replace[x.ID]; ok {
+			out = append(out, y)
+		} else {
+			out = append(out, x)
+		}
+	}
+	out = append(out, c.Added...)
+	sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].ID < out[j].ID })
+	var specs strings.Builder
+	for _, x := range out {
+		specs.WriteString(contracts.RenderItem(x))
+		specs.WriteString("\n")
+	}
+	d.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body, "Specs", strings.TrimSpace(specs.String())+"\n")
+	if set, ok := c.Document.Frontmatter["set"].(map[string]any); ok {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			d.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	dec, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Decisions")
+	removed, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Removed decisions")
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if line != "" {
+			dec = strings.ReplaceAll(dec, line, "")
+		}
+	}
+	added, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Decisions")
+	added = strings.TrimSpace(added)
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				dec += "\n- " + c.Slug + ": " + line
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	d.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(dec)+"\n")
+	render, e := contracts.RenderDocument(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = os.WriteFile(path, []byte(render), 0644); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func Context(root, selector string, full bool) (string, error) {
+	s, e := Current(root, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	var out strings.Builder
+	out.WriteString("# Change\n")
+	body, _ := contracts.RenderDocument(s.Change.Document)
+	out.WriteString(body)
+	m, ok := module(s.Snapshot, s.Change.Module)
+	if ok {
+		out.WriteString("\n# Projected spec\n")
+		b, _ := contracts.RenderDocument(m.Document)
+		out.WriteString(b)
+	}
+	sys, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, "SYSTEM.md"))
+	out.WriteString("\n# SYSTEM\n")
+	out.Write(sys)
+	pb := s.Phase
+	if pb == "impl" && fmBool(s.Change.Document, "regenerate") {
+		pb = "regenerate"
+	}
+	play, e := assets.Playbook(pb)
+	if e == nil {
+		out.WriteString("\n# Playbook\n")
+		out.WriteString(play)
+	}
+	if ok {
+		for _, pattern := range m.Zones.Interface {
+			_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+				if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+					return nil
+				}
+				rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir), path)
+				rel = filepath.ToSlash(rel)
+				if !contracts.MatchGlob(pattern, rel) {
+					return nil
+				}
+				b, er := os.ReadFile(path)
+				if er == nil {
+					out.WriteString("\n# " + filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, rel)) + "\n")
+					out.Write(b)
+				}
+				return nil
+			})
+		}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(s.Snapshot.Root, path)
+			if rel == "" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			for _, p := range m.Zones.Interface {
+				if contracts.MatchGlob(p, strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Dir+"/")) {
+					return nil
+				}
+			}
+			info, er := d.Info()
+			if er != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			out.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n# %s (%d bytes)\n", filepath.ToSlash(rel), info.Size()))
+			if full {
+				b, er := os.ReadFile(path)
+				if er == nil {
+					out.Write(b)
+				}
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	return out.String(), nil
+}
+
+func Costs(root string) ([]model.CostSnapshot, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(r, ".fireweed", "runs")
+	out := []model.CostSnapshot{}
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+		if err != nil || d.IsDir() || d.Name() != "costs.json" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, er := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if er != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		var s model.CostSnapshot
+		if json.Unmarshal(b, &s) == nil {
+			out = append(out, s)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt) })
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	s, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	out := model.StatusReport{Modules: s.Modules, Queue: []model.StatusEntry{}, DriftSinceDrill: map[string]int{}, PhaseCommits: map[string]int{}, Costs: []model.ModuleCost{}}
+	for i, c := range q {
+		phase := fmString(c.Document, "phase")
+		if phase == "" {
+			phase = "queued"
+		}
+		x := model.StatusEntry{Slug: c.Slug, Path: c.Path, Module: c.Module, Phase: phase, Blocked: fmString(c.Document, "blocked"), AuditRounds: fmInt(c.Document, "audit_rounds")}
+		if x.Blocked == "" {
+			x.WaitingOn, x.WaitingRule = waiting(r, q, i)
+		}
+		out.Queue = append(out.Queue, x)
+	}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		for _, it := range specItems(m) {
+			if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "quarantine") {
+				reason := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(it.Tag, "quarantine:"))
+				out.Quarantines = append(out.Quarantines, model.Quarantine{Module: m.Name, ID: it.ID, Reason: reason})
+			}
+		}
+		if v, ok := m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"].(string); ok && v != "" {
+			out.BoundaryOptOuts = append(out.BoundaryOptOuts, model.BoundaryOptOut{Module: m.Name, Reason: v})
+		}
+		out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name] = 0
+	}
+	archives, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(r,"changes","archive","*.md"))
+	type applied struct { module,path string; date time.Time }
+	all := []applied{}
+	for _,path := range archives {
+		b,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil{continue}
+		doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if err!=nil||fmString(doc,"phase")!="applied"{continue}
+		mod:=fmString(doc,"module")
+		date:=implDate(doc)
+		all=append(all,applied{module:mod,path:path,date:date})
+		name:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path),".md")
+		if commits,err:=Commits(r,name);err==nil{out.PhaseCommits[name]=len(commits)}
+	}
+	sort.Slice(all,func(i,j int)bool{if all[i].date.Equal(all[j].date){return all[i].path<all[j].path};return all[i].date.After(all[j].date)})
+	if len(all)>=3 {
+		count:=1
+		for count<len(all)&&all[count].module==all[0].module{count++}
+		if count>=3{out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:"P08",Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes",all[0].module,count),Warning:true})}
+	}
+	for _,m:=range s.Modules {
+		var drill time.Time
+		if b,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(r,".fireweed","drills",m.Name+".md"));err==nil{if d,er:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));er==nil{drill=parseDate(fmt.Sprint(d.Frontmatter["date"]))}}
+		for _,x:=range all{if x.module==m.Name&&(drill.IsZero()||x.date.After(drill)){out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]++}}
+	}
+	base,_:=s.Config["base"].(string);if base==""{base="main"}
+	remote,_:=s.Config["remote"].(string);if remote==""{remote="origin"}
+	ref,err:=git(r,"rev-parse","--verify","refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
+	if err!=nil{ref,_=git(r,"rev-parse","--verify",base)}
+	for _,x:=range all{rel,_:=filepath.Rel(r,x.path);if _,err:=gitBytes(r,"show",ref+":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel));err!=nil{out.Unapproved++}}
+	costs, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	latestDiagnostics:=map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, snap := range costs {
+		for _, c := range snap.Modules {
+			latest[c.Module] = c
+			latestDiagnostics[c.Module]=snap.Diagnostics
+		}
+	}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if c, ok := latest[m.Name]; ok {
+			out.Costs = append(out.Costs, c)
+			for _,d:=range latestDiagnostics[m.Name]{
+				if d.Code!="B01"&&d.Code!="B02"&&d.Code!="B03"{continue}
+				found:=false;for _,existing:=range out.Diagnostics{if existing==d{found=true;break}}
+				if !found{out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,d)}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+func parseDate(s string)time.Time{t,_:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,strings.TrimSpace(s));return t}
+func implDate(doc contracts.Document)time.Time{body,_:=contracts.Section(doc.Body,"Provenance");var date time.Time;for _,line:=range strings.Split(body,"\n"){f:=strings.Fields(line);if len(f)>=3&&f[0]=="-"&&f[1]=="impl"{date=parseDate(f[2])}};return date}
+
+func selectorPaths(root, selector string) (string, string, error) {
+	if selector == "" {
+		return "", "", coded("U02", "change selector missing")
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	paths := []string{}
+	for _, c := range q {
+		paths = append(paths, c.Path)
+	}
+	arch, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive", "*.md"))
+	for _, p := range arch {
+		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, p)
+		paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(rel))
+	}
+	matches := []string{}
+	for _, p := range paths {
+		base := filepath.Base(p)
+		slug := strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".md")
+		if i := strings.IndexByte(slug, '-'); i >= 0 {
+			slug = slug[i+1:]
+		}
+		if selector == p || selector == base || selector == slug || selector == strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".md") {
+			matches = append(matches, p)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(matches) != 1 {
+		valid:=[]string{}
+		for _,p:=range paths { name:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p),".md");if i:=strings.IndexByte(name,'-');i>=0{name=name[i+1:]};valid=append(valid,name) }
+		sort.Strings(valid)
+		return "", "", coded("U02", fmt.Sprintf("change %q not found or ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector,strings.Join(valid,", ")))
+	}
+	return matches[0], filepath.Base(matches[0]), nil
+}
+func Commits(root, selector string) ([]string, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	path, base, e := selectorPaths(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	paths := []string{path}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+		paths = append(paths, "changes/"+base)
+	} else {
+		paths = append(paths, "changes/archive/"+base)
+	}
+	logs, e := git(r, "rev-list", "HEAD", "--", paths[0], paths[1])
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []string{}
+	for _, oid := range strings.Fields(logs) {
+		parent, err := git(r, "rev-parse", oid+"^")
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		before, be := gitBytes(r, "show", parent+":"+paths[0])
+		if be != nil {
+			before, _ = gitBytes(r, "show", parent+":"+paths[1])
+		}
+		after, ae := gitBytes(r, "show", oid+":"+paths[0])
+		if ae != nil {
+			after, _ = gitBytes(r, "show", oid+":"+paths[1])
+		}
+		bd, ber := contracts.ParseDocument(string(before))
+		ad, aer := contracts.ParseDocument(string(after))
+		if ber == nil && aer == nil && fmString(bd, "phase") != fmString(ad, "phase") {
+			out = append(out, oid)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Abandon(root, selector string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = clean(r); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	path, _, e := selectorPaths(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+		return "", coded("P01", "applied change cannot be abandoned")
+	}
+	c, e := currentChange(r, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	oid, exists, err := gitstore.Ref(r, refName(c))
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if exists {
+		_, _, err = loadClaim(r, c)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", err
+		}
+	}
+	commits, e := Commits(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	for _, x := range commits {
+		if _, e = git(r, "revert", "--no-commit", x); e != nil {
+			return "", e
+		}
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(r, path)); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "-A", "--", path); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "commit", "-m", "fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if exists {
+		_ = gitstore.CASRef(r, refName(c), oid, "")
+	}
+	return git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+}
+
+type endpointConfigError struct{ cause error }
+
+func (e endpointConfigError) Error() string { return e.cause.Error() }
+func (e endpointConfigError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error) bool  { var x endpointConfigError; return errors.As(err, &x) }
+func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
+	}
+	if revisionRange == "" {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "empty range")
+	}
+	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
+	if len(parts) != 2 {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "unresolvable range "+revisionRange)
+	}
+	from, e := git(r, "rev-parse", parts[0])
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", revisionRange+": "+e.Error())
+	}
+	to, e := git(r, "rev-parse", parts[1])
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", revisionRange+": "+e.Error())
+	}
+	snap, e := project.LoadAt(r, to)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, endpointConfigError{e}
+	}
+	changes, e := git(r, "diff", "--name-only", from, to)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
+	}
+	endpoint, e := git(r,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",to,"--","changes")
+	if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},e}
+	endpointByName:=map[string]string{}
+	for _,path:=range strings.Fields(endpoint){if strings.HasSuffix(path,".md"){endpointByName[filepath.Base(path)]=path}}
+	selected:=map[string]string{}
+	for _,path:=range strings.Fields(changes){if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/"){if p,ok:=endpointByName[filepath.Base(path)];ok{selected[filepath.Base(path)]=p}}}
+	names:=make([]string,0,len(selected));for name:=range selected{names=append(names,name)};sort.Strings(names)
+	var b strings.Builder
+	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# Changes %s..%s\n\n", from, to)
+	for _,name:=range names{
+		path:=selected[name]
+		raw, err := gitBytes(r, "show", to+":"+path)
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		kind:="spec";if len(stringsOf(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]))>0{kind="eval_fix"}else if len(stringsOf(doc.Frontmatter["fixes"]))>0{kind="fix"}else if fmBool(doc,"regenerate"){kind="regenerate"}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## %s\n\nModule: %s\n\nKind: %s\n\nAudit rounds: %d\n\n", path, fmString(doc, "module"),kind,fmInt(doc,"audit_rounds"))
+		for _, n := range []string{"Added", "Modified", "Audit", "Decisions", "Removed decisions", "Provenance"} {
+			body, ok := contracts.Section(doc.Body, n)

+func GC(ctx context.Context, request model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(request.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	s, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	age := 720 * time.Hour
+	if x, ok := configMap(s, "gc")["drill_max_age"].(string); ok && x != "" {
+		age, e = time.ParseDuration(x)
+		if e != nil || age <= 0 {
+			return model.GCResult{}, coded("C01", "invalid gc.drill_max_age")
+		}
+	}
+	now := request.Now
+	if now.IsZero() {
+		now = time.Now().UTC()
+	}
+	listing, e := git(r, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/fireweed/claims", "refs/fireweed/attempts", "refs/fireweed/drills")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	out := model.GCResult{Pruned: []string{}}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(listing, "\n") {
+		parts := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(parts) != 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		ref, oid := parts[0], parts[1]
+		prune := false
+		if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/claims/") {
+			b, err := gitstore.ReadBlob(r, oid)
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			var x claim
+			if json.Unmarshal(b, &x) != nil {
+				prune = true
+			} else {
+				info, err := repo(x.Worktree)
+				prune = err != nil || info.CommonDir != "" && info.CommonDir != (func() string { z, _ := repo(r); return z.CommonDir }())
+			}
+		} else if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/attempts/") {
+			seg := strings.Split(ref, "/")
+			if len(seg) >= 5 {
+				_, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(r, "changes/archive", seg[3]+".md"))
+				prune = err == nil
+				if !prune {
+					matches, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(r, "changes/archive", "*-"+seg[3]+".md"))
+					prune = len(matches) > 0
+				}
+			}
+		} else if strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/drills/") {
+			seg := strings.Split(ref, "/")
+			stamp := seg[len(seg)-1]
+			t, err := time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000", stamp)
+			if err == nil {
+				prune = t.Before(now.Add(-age))
+			}
+		}
+		if prune {
+			if err := gitstore.CASRef(r, ref, oid, ""); err == nil {
+				out.Pruned = append(out.Pruned, ref)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(out.Pruned)
+	return out, nil
+}

+package lifecycle
